Post-inference source-correspondence audit, not blinded or independent clinical validation.

Reader9 records directory and predecessor reviewer-1 filename search contained no records for these four PMIDs on arrival; no predecessor reading credit invented. Curated subscription inputs were prepared but Claude used zero tokens and performed no review.
Main Table1 pixels were inspected in a faithful cell-text rendering of held publisher HTML, not original publisher typography.

Figure1 legend misassigns gestational ages: F1=13+5, F2.1=21+6, F2.2=22+1, whereas Table1 and supplement consistently give F1=22+1, F2.1=13+5, F2.2=21+6. F2.2 right-foot ectrodactyly in main table versus octadactyly in supplement remains a source discrepancy.
TableS2 predicts Glu218Lys stabilising (+0.396 kcal/mol), while main text broadly suggests impaired stability; this variant was not in the cellular rescue experiment.
